title: Cracking suppression in selective electron beam melted WMoTaNbC refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by selective electron beam melting under a vacuum atmosphere of 10⁻¹ Pa with preheating of the substrate at 1100 ℃, using a running voltage of 60 kV, current of 18–20 mA, and scanning rate of 1.0 m/s.
